title: One-page checkout for a grocery app
problem: Shoppers dropped out between delivery and payment; the checkout had four steps and asked for the address twice.
constraints: Payment provider's hosted card field could not be restyled

decisions.choice: Collapse delivery, payment and review into one page with editable summaries
decisions.why: Usability sessions showed people wanted to see the total and delivery slot together
decisions.tradeOff: A longer page on small phones, solved with collapsed sections

decisions.choice: Save the delivery slot before payment
rejected: Hold the slot only after payment
decisions.why: Slots sold out while people typed card details
